observation.command: echo "=== Confirm @sw-code not on public npm (both frontends depend on it) ==="; for p in urbo-core urbo-ui urbo-cms-core urbo-backend-api urbo-file-api; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://registry.npmjs.org/@sw-code%2F$p"); echo "@sw-code/$p on public npm: $code"; done; echo; echo "=== Confirm private registry 401 without token ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "npm.pkg.github.com tarball: %{http_code}\n" "https://npm.pkg.github.com/download/@sw-code/urbo-core/2.0.268/3b99378d594249f34d24ea1ef24ff7630c914acc"; echo; echo "=== Token availability ==="; [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ] && echo "GITHUB_TOKEN: SET" || echo "GITHUB_TOKEN: NOT SET"; grep -c "_authToken=" /workspace/app/.npmrc /workspace/cms/.npmrc 2>/dev/null
